description: This source file implements an event producer for device events, including initialization, shutdown, and broadcasting various device-related events such as discovery, resource updates, device addition/removal, and configuration status. It interacts with external modules for logging, IPC, device management, and JSON encoding.

methods.name: startDeviceEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the event producer, setting up the producer pointer if not already initialized.

methods.name: stopDeviceEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the event producer and resets the producer pointer.

methods.name: sendDiscoveryStartedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a discovery started event with device classes and timeout.

methods.name: sendDiscoveryStoppedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a discovery stopped event for a specific device class.

methods.name: sendDeviceDiscoveredEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device discovered event with device details.

methods.name: sendDeviceDiscoveryFailedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device discovery failed event with device UUID and class.

methods.name: sendDeviceRejectedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device rejected event with device details.

methods.name: sendDeviceDiscoveryCompletedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device discovery completed event with device info.

methods.name: sendDeviceAddedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device added event with device UUID.

methods.name: sendDeviceRecoveredEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device recovered event with device UUID.

methods.name: sendDeviceRemovedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device removed event with UUID and device class.

methods.name: sendResourceUpdatedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a resource updated event with resource details and optional metadata.

methods.name: sendEndpointAddedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an endpoint added event with endpoint info and device class.

methods.name: sendEndpointRemovedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an endpoint removed event with endpoint info and device class.

methods.name: sendReadyForDevicesEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a ready for devices event.

methods.name: sendZigbeeChannelChangedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a Zigbee channel change event with success status and channels.

methods.name: sendZigbeeNetworkInterferenceEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a Zigbee network interference detection event.

methods.name: sendZigbeePanIdAttackEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a Zigbee PAN ID attack detection event.

methods.name: sendDeviceConfigureStartedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device configuration started event with device class and UUID.

methods.name: sendDeviceConfigureCompletedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device configuration completed event with device class and UUID.

methods.name: sendDeviceConfigureFailedEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a device configuration failed event with device class and UUID.
